content.text: In regions where traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-only-real|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal restrict access, establishing a digital store can feel impossible. Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe experience these limitations that hinder digital creators. [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-13|GitHub Pages]].io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-which-architecture-actually-16|coremerch]] provides a solution with Stack 01, built on GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, offering a straightforward path to set up your store and accept crypto payments without depending on conventional platforms. You can achieve full ownership of your store's infrastructure with no ongoing fees and immediate access to your data. This guide walks you through using Supabase as your order database, ensuring you get your store live without the limitations imposed by traditional services.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Using GitHub Pages and Apps Script ensures that you have a robust foundation for your digital store. These platforms are reliable and free, eliminating the risk of sudden account freezes or payment processing issues common with traditional payment services. With this infrastructure, you gain sovereignty over your digital assets. Stack 01 is designed specifically for regions with restricted payment options, allowing creators to move beyond reliance on conventional platforms. By leveraging tools like Supabase for order management and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you create a seamless experience that allows you to focus on your products, not payment hurdles.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your store, gather the necessary tools and assets. You’ll need a GitHub account to host your site and a Google account to set up Apps Script. Prepare your digital products for upload, ensuring they are ready for sale. Create a NOWPayments account to manage your cryptocurrency transactions effectively. Familiarize yourself with Supabase, as it will serve as your order database. Check that your products are formatted correctly for delivery and that you have high-quality branding assets to create a professional appearance. Having these elements in place will streamline your deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools in place, it’s time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Start by deploying your GitHub Pages site, following the Sovereign Blueprint for Stack 01. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions by utilizing their API for seamless payment processing. After integration, set up Supabase to track orders and customer data. This involves creating tables for storing transactions and linking them with the products being sold. Test your payment flow by making a test transaction to ensure everything is functioning correctly before going live.
Own your digital store's infrastructure entirely, without reliance on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your payment pipeline set up and tested, you’re ready to go live. Announce your store to your audience, providing clear instructions on how to navigate your site and make purchases. Monitor your first transactions closely to ensure that payments are processed correctly and that customers receive their products without delay. Use the insights gained from these initial sales to refine your process and improve customer experience. This feedback loop is crucial for maintaining a reliable e-commerce presence.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live and running smoothly, consider scaling your operations. With Stack 01, you can easily add more products to your inventory and integrate additional payment options through NOWPayments. Monitor customer behavior and sales analytics via Supabase to identify trends and adjust your offerings accordingly. You can also explore upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced features and more robust capabilities. This will set you up for long-term success and allow you to adapt to the growing demands of your customer base.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, leverage Stack 01 by using GitHub Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend logic. With NOWPayments, you can process transactions securely without KYC requirements. This infrastructure allows you to maintain complete ownership and control over your store's operations.
Deploy your store in just a few hours, achieving sovereignty over your transactions.

Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account for hosting your site. Set up a Google account for Google Apps Script access. Prepare your digital products for upload. Register for NOWPayments to manage cryptocurrency transactions. Familiarize yourself with Supabase for order management. Deploy your GitHub Pages site following the Sovereign Blueprint. Integrate NOWPayments and configure Supabase. Test your payment process with a sample transaction. Launch your store and monitor the first transactions closely. Utilize feedback for continuous improvement.
